basic_info.description: Fully renovated, sophisticated, and modern smart home in Outer Parkside. This luxurious 2,878 sq. ft. residence offers 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. The upper level features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a stunning ocean-view primary suite with a walk-in closet and a spa-like ensuite. The open kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. The lower level boasts a spacious family room with a wet bar, two additional ensuite bedrooms, and direct access to a professionally landscaped backyard. Additional highlights include a laundry room, a 1-car garage, a tankless water heater, and an EV charging. Ideally located near St. Ignatius, St. Gabriel, and Ulloa Elementary, this home offers easy access to Ocean Beach for nature lovers. Enjoy nearby city conveniences, including shops, grocery stores, restaurants, and cafs along Taraval Street. Whether you're seeking a cozy coffee spot, a neighborhood market, or public transit, everything you need is just moments away!
